request.spec:
The sheet gains a rounding mode (settings, dated like the floor; SETTING_CHANGED key=rounding
value=<half-up or half-even>; anything else is refused with an error on the settings; blank means
none). A claim whose date has a rounding mode in force rounds every live figure by that mode; a
claim with none in force on its date rounds by the policy date as before.
request.prompt:

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet gains a rounding mode (settings, dated like the floor; SETTING_CHANGED key=rounding
value=<half-up or half-even>; anything else is refused with an error on the settings; blank means
none). A claim whose date has a rounding mode in force rounds every live figure by that mode; a

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The sheet now has a dated rounding-mode setting, and all 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

**What changed**
- **The setting** (`setting/Settings.java`, `ValidateSetting.java`): a new `rounding` key, dated like the floor. It accepts `half-up`, `half-even` or blank (blank means none). Anything else is refused and the settings error shows. The existing save step writes the audit line as `SETTING_CHANGED … key=rounding value=<v> from=<date>`. Settings are stored as key/value rows, so no database migration was needed.
- **Server rounding** (`claim/Late.java`): `Late.rounding(claim)` first looks for a rounding mode in force on the date the claim rounds on. If there is one, it uses it; if not, it falls back to the policy date as before. Every live figure, late charges included, already goes through this one method.
- **Front-end rounding** (`claims/claims.ts`, `settings/settings.ts`): the same rule is in `roundsHalfUp`, using a new `useRoundingMode` hook. The screen and the server always show the same figures.
- **Settings screen** (`settings.slot.tsx`): a rounding-mode field with `setting-rounding`, `setting-rounding-from` and `setting-rounding-current`. Saving a blank value clears it, the same way the other blank-able fields work.
- **As-of view** (`SheetState`/`SheetStates`): sheet states saved from now on include the rounding history, so viewing the sheet as of a date uses the right mode. States saved before this change are read as having no mode.

**One fix outside the request.** Scenario 1 failed on something that has nothing to do with rounding, and the bug was already there before my change. When the sheet's today moved on, `sheet/SaveToday.java` saved each person's snapshot line *before* it saved the copy of the sheet used for the as-of view. So viewing the sheet as of 2026-03-20 wrongly showed the snapshot taken when that day was left. I swapped the order so the copy is saved first. The audit lines are written in the same order as before.

For a correction, the mode is looked up on the date of the claim it corrects, as the policy date already does, rather than the correction's own date. I chose this to match the existing rule; the tests don't cover it.
